summary: GOWell Technology Limited and Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V (NASDAQ: IPEX) closed their business combination on September 25, 2026, following shareholder approval on September 3, 2026; the combined entity is renamed GOWell Energy Technology and begins trading on Nasdaq under GOW as of September 28, 2026. Concurrently, a roughly $50 million PIPE of preferred shares and warrants closed, adding to about $20 million privately placed at the October 2025 signing, for $70 million gross proceeds. No price per share, implied value, or premium was disclosed.
